notes.title: Update for bug fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38768970/a50bf89e3e2aad9bcc414e47f562c00699f50512.png[/img]

Fixed a bug that occurred when drafting rankeds matches, where the game froze and it was necessary to close it,

Added a "Back" button at draft time, preventing the player from losing their progress if some other bug happens.

notes.title: PRO PLAYER LIFE - UPDATE 2.0
notes.content:
UPGRADE 2.0
We are releasing the Pro Player Life 2.0 update.


The following is a list of what has been changed, added or removed in this update.

[b]New save system:[/b]
There are now 2 independent save systems, ensuring greater integrity for the files.


[b]My team page:[/b]
Now when accessing the Gamer Center menu, it will be possible to see information about your team, teammates, teamplay, classification points, etc.


[b]Ranked reformulation:[/b]
Before starting a ranked match you must go through a draft, assembling your team in the best possible way, while the opposing captain will try to do the same.


[b]Added Team Play:[/b]
Your level of team play with your teammates will help you to achieve a better performance during official matches.
It is possible to increase the level of team play by playing ranked with a teammate or between qualifiers and championships, where the player will follow his training routine inside the Gaming House, together with his teammates.


[b]Added Tactical Advantage and Bootcamp:[/b]
Each official competition, you will be able to perform 1 bootcamp that will provide a tactical advantage for the next matches. Choose whether you want the advantage for qualifiers or championships.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1[/b]

Thanks to everyone's feedback, we were able to notice that some players were encountering difficulties throughout their journey in Pro Player Life. 
To ensure a better gameplay experience for everyone, we decided to make some updates today.

[b]Update notes:[/b]

Added a hint of which tactic to use during rankeds matches.

We have improved your personal assistant's welcome messages.

New category in the help menu
[i]-A SUCCESSFUL CAREER[/i]

In this new category, you will find information on how to achieve success in Pro Player Life.

We made some adjustments during competitive matches and rankeds, so that bad decisions become less punitive.

We added a block at bedtime, preventing this activity from being performed if the player has a lot of energy.

We added an audible and visual alert if the player tries to go to official matches without distributing all his skill points.


[i]Attention:
If you were having difficulty progressing your career within Pro Player Life, we suggest that you start a new game to enjoy the improvements we have made.
If you were doing well in your current game, we alert you that your experience may be compromised when loading your game after the update. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.[/i]


We thank everyone for their support, and we want to invite you to continue sending feedbacks and suggestions.
